title: Cell Delta SOC Estimator (Kalman Filter)
text: State of charge estimator with cell delta Kalman filter, 6 inputs, 1 output, {Filter type} sets Kalman; {Specify Current input as cell current(s)} sets the option, {Alpha}, {Beta}, {Kappa}, {Covariance of the process noise, Q}, {Covariance of the measurement noise, R}, {Initial state error covariance, P0}, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample, {Vector of state-of-charge values, SOC (-)} sets the sOC breakpoints, {Vector of temperatures, T} sets the temperature, {Terminal resistance, R0(SOC,T), (ohm)} sets the r0 lookup table with temperature breakpoint, {No-load voltage, V0(SOC,T), (V)} sets the v 0 lookup table 3.55, 3.57, 3.56; 3.62, 3.63, 3.64; 3.71, 3.71, 3.72; 3.91, 3.93, 3.94; {Algorithm data type} sets the option to choose data type for block algorithm. Values come from the instance.

params.values: Kalman filter type Extended Kalman filter (default) | Extended Kalman-Bucy filter | Unscented Kalman filter | Unscented Kalman-Bucy filter

params.name: Vector of state-of-charge values, SOC (-)

params.name: Vector of temperatures, T
params.values: Temperature breakpoints [278, 293, 313] (default) | vector of positive scalars

params.values: Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
